description: This PHP file defines a class `Order` within the OpenCart admin module, specifically for handling order report tasks. It includes methods for initializing tasks related to different order statuses (sale, processing, complete, other) and for generating corresponding reports by querying order data and updating statistics.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Controller class for generating order-related reports and managing order report tasks within the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes order report tasks for sale, processing, complete, and other statuses and returns success message.

methods.name: sale
methods.description: Generates sales order statistics and returns a success message.

methods.name: processing
methods.description: Generates processing order statistics and returns a success message.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Generates completed order statistics and returns a success message.

methods.name: other
methods.description: Generates statistics for orders with statuses other than complete and processing, and returns a success message.
